question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'In'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1 is**: 'in'.**
 
• The preposition **"in"** is used with years. So, when referring to a specific year, we use "in". For example, "in 1850", "in 2021", etc. 
 
• The sentence is stating that Jane died within the course of the year 1850, so **"in"** is the appropriate choice.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On:** This preposition is used with specific dates or days. For example, "on July 4th", "on Monday", etc.
 
• **Into:** This preposition is typically used to express movement or transformation. For example, "She went into the room", "He turned into a wolf", etc. It's not appropriate in this context.
 
• **At:** This preposition is used to denote a specific time, or a specific place. For example, "at 3 o'clock", "at the station", etc. It's not typically used with years.
